title: [Cloudsea Odyssey] I Finally Wrote a Novel!

blocks.source: 【雲海のオデッセイ】ねんがんの小説を書きました！
blocks.translation: [Cloudsea Odyssey] I Finally Wrote a Novel!

blocks.source: ねんがんの小説を書きました！
blocks.translation: I finally wrote a novel!

blocks.source: ここ何年かロクに表立った活動をしてきませんでしたが、ようやく表に出す時が来たようです。
blocks.translation: I haven't done much public-facing work for the past few years, but it seems the time has finally come to step into the limelight.

blocks.source: 雲海のオデッセイ
blocks.translation: Cloudsea Odyssey

blocks.source: https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0109fq/
blocks.translation: https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0109fq/

blocks.source: 小説家になろうにて、ひっそりと毎日連載していきます。
blocks.translation: I’ll be quietly posting a new installment every day on Narō.

blocks.source: 内容は雲の上の世界を冒険する剣と魔法の王道ファンタジーです。
blocks.translation: It’s a classic sword-and-sorcery fantasy about adventuring through a world above the clouds.

blocks.source: ゲームだろうが、小説だろうが相変わらず王道ファンタジー至上主義は変わりません。
blocks.translation: Whether it’s a game or a novel, my devotion to classic fantasy remains unchanged.

blocks.source: 過去の偉大なＲＰＧや小説からインスピレーションを受けながらも、自分の持てる限りのアイデアを注ぎ込みました。
blocks.translation: While drawing inspiration from great RPGs and novels of the past, I’ve poured in as many of my own ideas as I could.

blocks.source: 以下、作品の特徴。
blocks.translation: Here are the work’s features.

blocks.source: 異世界に転移しません。
blocks.translation: There is no transfer to another world.

blocks.source: 主人公は最初からファンタジー世界の住人です。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is a native of the fantasy world from the very beginning.

blocks.source: 主人公はそれなりに強いですが、最強ではありません。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is fairly strong, but not the strongest.

blocks.source: 仲間と力を合わせながら冒険します。
blocks.translation: They go on adventures by joining forces with their companions.

blocks.source: 第一章からいるヒロインがずっと物語の中核です。
blocks.translation: The heroine who appears from Chapter One remains at the heart of the story throughout.

blocks.source: イベントをクリアする度にヒロインが増えたりはしません。
blocks.translation: The number of heroines does not increase every time an event is cleared.

blocks.source: ストーリーは章毎に明確な目的を持って進みます。
blocks.translation: The story progresses with a clear objective for each chapter.

blocks.source: 完結までのプロットも作成済みです。
blocks.translation: The plot through to the conclusion has already been created.

blocks.source: 明るめな作風にしたつもりですが、それなりに過酷な展開もあります。
blocks.translation: I intended to give it a fairly upbeat tone, but there are some reasonably harsh developments as well.

blocks.source: 特に第二章辺りまで。
blocks.translation: Especially up through around Chapter Two.

blocks.source: ステータス、レベルなどのゲーム的な概念はありません。
blocks.translation: There are no game-like concepts such as stats or levels.

blocks.source: 作者はゲーム作家ですがありません。
blocks.translation: The author is a game creator, but there isn’t one.

blocks.source: タイトルは長くありません。簡単に覚えられます。
blocks.translation: The title isn’t long. It’s easy to remember.

blocks.source: ※サブタイは付けるかも？
blocks.translation: ※I might add a subtitle?

blocks.source: 以上。
blocks.translation: That’s all.

blocks.source: テンプレ？ なにそれ、おいしいの？ という感じの王道ファンタジーです。
blocks.translation: It’s a classic fantasy where you might say, “A template? What’s that—can you eat it?”

blocks.source: ※Ｗｅｂ小説の世界では一定の型にはまった小説が人気を集めやすい傾向があり、『テンプレ』と呼ばれています。
blocks.translation: ※In the world of web fiction, novels that follow certain established formulas tend to attract more readers, and are called “templates.”

blocks.source: ……と言いながらも、テンプレの分かりやすさと面白さはなかなか侮れません。
blocks.translation: …That said, the clarity and entertainment value of templates shouldn’t be underestimated.

blocks.source: Ｗｅｂ小説全般で旧来のハイファンタジーが流行らないのは、それなりに理由があるのだろうな――とは考えています。
blocks.translation: I do think there are understandable reasons why traditional high fantasy isn’t popular in web fiction generally.

blocks.source: そこはテンプレ並に読みやすい小説を目指したいところです。文学ではなくエンタメを作っているつもりなので、敷居の低さは重要でしょう。
blocks.translation: That’s where I want to aim for a novel that’s as easy to read as a template. I intend to create entertainment rather than literature, so keeping the barrier to entry low should be important.

blocks.source: ちなみにわりとガチでやります。１００万字は絶対に超えます。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, I’m taking this fairly seriously. It will definitely exceed one million characters.

blocks.source: 完成形になれば、ミスティックスターをクリアする二倍ぐらいは読了にかかると思います。
blocks.translation: Once complete, I expect it will take about twice as long to read as it takes to finish Mystic Star.

blocks.source: 動機＆経緯
blocks.translation: Motivation & Background

blocks.source: ミスティックスターを完成させて以降、次に何を目指すかを考えていました。
blocks.translation: After completing Mystic Star, I was thinking about what to aim for next.

blocks.source: というのも、ぶっちゃけ王道路線のゲームデザインとしては、自分ではあれ以上のものを作れる気がしません。
blocks.translation: To be frank, when it comes to classic game design, I don’t feel I can make anything better than that.

blocks.source: ちょっと違う程度のものなら作れるでしょうが、このままやっていてもたぶん頭打ちです。
blocks.translation: I could probably make something slightly different, but if I continued along this path, I’d likely hit my limit.

blocks.source: ここは違う方向性を開拓してみようと考えました。
blocks.translation: I decided to try exploring a different direction.

blocks.source: できそうな方向性は二つ。
blocks.translation: There were two directions I thought might work.

blocks.source: ストーリーや世界設定などを強化する。
blocks.translation: Strengthen the story, worldbuilding, and so on.

blocks.source: 自由度を増し、戦闘以前のゲーム性を強化する。
blocks.translation: Increase freedom and strengthen the gameplay outside of battle.

blocks.source: イメージとしてはサガシリーズやメタルマックス２Ｒなど。
blocks.translation: I had series such as SaGa and Metal Max 2R in mind.

blocks.source: そして、ひとまず前者を選びました。
blocks.translation: And for the time being, I chose the former.

blocks.source: 正直に言うと、ストーリーには苦手意識がありました。自分は現状、明らかにストーリーよりもシステム寄りのゲーム作家です。
blocks.translation: To be honest, I had always felt uncomfortable with storytelling. At present, I’m clearly a game creator who focuses more on systems than story.

blocks.source: 才能がない――とまでは思いません。単なる経験不足でしょう。
blocks.translation: I wouldn’t go so far as to say I lack talent. I’m probably just inexperienced.

blocks.source: 思えば子供の頃、学校でやらされる作文がめっちゃ苦手だった記憶があります。自分をさらけ出すということには、誰しも抵抗を持つもの。ストーリーが苦手だったのもその延長でしょう。
blocks.translation: Come to think of it, I remember being terrible at the essays we were made to write at school as a child. Everyone feels some resistance to exposing themselves. My difficulty with stories probably stems from the same place.

blocks.source: それゆえ、長らくゲーム制作ではストーリーよりもゲーム性にばかり力を入れてきました。
blocks.translation: As a result, for a long time I focused on gameplay rather than story in my game development.

blocks.source: 結局、始めてオリジナルのストーリーを真面目に作ろうとしたのは、ミスティックスターが始めてと言ってよいレベルです。
blocks.translation: In the end, it’s fair to say that Mystic Star was the first time I seriously tried to create an original story.

blocks.source: それまで中～長編を６本以上完成させておきながらそんな有様。ミスタ開発当初はどうストーリーを作ればよいのか、強烈に悩んだほどです。
blocks.translation: That was despite having already completed more than six medium- to long-length games. When development on Mystic Star began, I was so troubled that I didn’t know how to create a story.

blocks.source: しかしながら、ストーリー作りが嫌いなわけではありません。むしろ思う存分、ゲーム性の成約がないところでストーリー作りをしてみたい。
blocks.translation: However, it’s not that I dislike creating stories. If anything, I wanted to try creating one to my heart’s content, without the constraints of gameplay.

blocks.source: そこで小説です。
blocks.translation: That’s where the novel comes in.

blocks.source: 自分も読者としては何百冊と読んでいますが、一度は書く側に回ってみたい。少し違うことをやりたいという思いもありました。
blocks.translation: I’ve read hundreds of books as a reader, but I wanted to try being on the writing side at least once. I also wanted to do something a little different.

blocks.source: 自分の作品なので、作風はミスティックスターを踏襲しています。読んでみれば、どことなく似たキャラクターがいることにも気づくと思います。
blocks.translation: Since it's my own work, its style follows Mystic Star. If you read it, I think you'll also notice some characters who seem vaguely similar.

blocks.source: また、雲海のオデッセイでは、ミスタでは力不足でできなかった点を改善したつもりです。
blocks.translation: Also, with Cloudsea Odyssey, I tried to improve on the things I couldn't do in Mista because of my limited abilities.

blocks.source: 具体的には……
blocks.translation: Specifically...

blocks.source: 特徴的な世界設定を行う。
blocks.translation: Create a distinctive world setting.

blocks.source: 冒頭シーンを印象的に。
blocks.translation: Make the opening scene memorable.

blocks.source: 大風呂敷を広げて先に期待をもたせる。
blocks.translation: Start with grand promises to build anticipation.

blocks.source: ヒロインを始め、キャラクターの登場を印象的に。
blocks.translation: Make the appearances of the characters, including the heroine, memorable.

blocks.source: ってな感じです。
blocks.translation: Something along those lines.

blocks.source: もちろん、ゲーム作家から転向するわけでもありません。
blocks.translation: Of course, I'm not changing careers from game creator to novelist.

blocks.source: というか、雲海シリーズとして類似した世界設定でゲーム化しても面白いと思っています。
blocks.translation: Actually, I think it would be interesting to turn it into a game with a similar world setting as part of the Cloudsea series.

blocks.source: イメージとしてはワイルドアームズシリーズが分かりやすいかなと。あれは『荒野の世界』という世界設定で、別々の物語を展開していますよね。
blocks.translation: For reference, I think the Wild Arms series is an easy comparison. It uses the world setting of a “wild frontier” and tells separate stories, doesn't it?

blocks.source: 実のところ、しばらくはこっそり名義変えて密かにやろうか悩みましたが、それはそれで色々と面倒なので普通にさらすことにしました。
blocks.translation: To tell the truth, I agonized over whether to quietly change my name and work on it in secret for a while, but that would have been troublesome in its own way, so I decided to put it out in the open.

blocks.source: 雲海のオデッセイには、王道ＲＰＧ魂をふんだんに盛り込んでいます。その一点ではブレはありません。
blocks.translation: Cloudsea Odyssey is packed with the spirit of classic RPGs. I have never wavered on that point.

blocks.source: ここは基本的にゲームブログですし、無理に読んでもらおうとはさすがに思いません。ですが、王道ＲＰＧが好き、小説も好きという方がいればどうぞ。
blocks.translation: This is basically a game blog, so I don't expect anyone to force themselves to read it. However, if you like classic RPGs and novels, please give it a look.

blocks.source: あと色々と事前研究をして知ったのですが、あっちも例によって、エターなる率が高い！ 最近はエタるなどと省略して呼ばれているそうです。
blocks.translation: I also learned through various bits of preliminary research that, as usual, the rate of projects going eternal over there is high! Apparently, these days they abbreviate it to “go eternal.”

blocks.source: どうやら、人気が出なければ見切りをつけて、次の作品に移る――というような、スタイルが横行しちゃってるようですね。多くの作品がエターなるのは悲しいことです。
blocks.translation: Apparently, a style of abandoning a work if it doesn't become popular and moving on to the next one has become widespread. It's sad that so many works go eternal.

blocks.source: どうでもいいですが、エターなるの語源は、ツクール２０００の伝説となった未完の大作エターナルファンタジアにあります。
blocks.translation: Not that it matters, but the term “go eternal” comes from Eternal Fantasia, an unfinished magnum opus that became legendary in RPG Maker 2000 circles.

blocks.source: そのエターナルファンタジアが盛大にエターなって、はや１８年。この言葉はすっかり世に定着してしまったようです。なんだか感慨深いものがありますね。
blocks.translation: It has already been 18 years since Eternal Fantasia went spectacularly eternal. The term seems to have become firmly established in society. It feels rather poignant.

blocks.source: ちなみに、小説家になろうの無名新人作家の場合、最初の読者数は精々数十人だそうです。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, in the case of an unknown newcomer on Shōsetsuka ni Narō, apparently the initial readership is at most a few dozen people.

blocks.source: 大量の作品があるのに、わざわざ無名作家の作品を読む必要はないというか、見つけるのも至難の業――というわけですね。
blocks.translation: Even with so many works available, there's little reason to go out of your way to read an unknown author's work—or rather, finding one is an incredibly difficult task.

blocks.source: 内容が良かろうが悪かろうが、そもそも最初は読む人が極端に少ないのだから、評価だってされません。
blocks.translation: Whether the content is good or bad, hardly anyone reads it at first, so it doesn't receive any reviews or ratings either.

blocks.source: まあ、そりゃそうだよなって感じですが。
blocks.translation: Well, I suppose that's only natural.

blocks.source: そこの現実を知らずに「評価が低くて落ち込む」→「エターなる」のコンボが初心者の定番らしいです。
blocks.translation: Apparently, the standard beginner's pattern is to be unaware of that reality, become depressed over low ratings, and then let the work go eternal.

blocks.source: 自分は気長に頑張りながら、上を目指していこうと思います。
blocks.translation: I intend to keep working patiently and aim higher.

blocks.source: 無論、人気が出ようが出まいが、僕はエターなりません。
blocks.translation: Regardless of whether it becomes popular, I will never let it go eternal.

blocks.source: 自分のスキルを磨くためにも、今は作りたいものを最後まで作りたい。結局のところ、自分にとってのモチベーションはそこですから。
blocks.translation: To hone my skills, I want to finish making what I want to make for now. In the end, that's what motivates me.

texts.実のところ、しばらくはこっそり名義変えて密かにやろうか悩みましたが、それはそれで: To tell the truth, I agonized over whether to quietly change my name and work on it in secret for a while, but that would have been troublesome in its own way, so I decided to put it out in the open.
texts.雲海のオデッセイには、王道ＲＰＧ魂をふんだんに盛り込んでいます。その一点ではブレ: Cloudsea Odyssey is packed with the spirit of classic RPGs. I have never wavered on that point.
texts.ここは基本的にゲームブログですし、無理に読んでもらおうとはさすがに思いません。で: This is basically a game blog, so I don't expect anyone to force themselves to read it. However, if you like classic RPGs and novels, please give it a look.
texts.あと色々と事前研究をして知ったのですが、あっちも例によって、エターなる率が高い！: I also learned through various bits of preliminary research that, as usual, the rate of projects going eternal over there is high! Apparently, these days they abbreviate it to “go eternal.”
texts.どうやら、人気が出なければ見切りをつけて、次の作品に移る――というような、スタイ: Apparently, a style of abandoning a work if it doesn't become popular and moving on to the next one has become widespread. It's sad that so many works go eternal.
texts.どうでもいいですが、エターなるの語源は、ツクール２０００の伝説となった未完の大作: Not that it matters, but the term “go eternal” comes from Eternal Fantasia, an unfinished magnum opus that became legendary in RPG Maker 2000 circles.
texts.そのエターナルファンタジアが盛大にエターなって、はや１８年。この言葉はすっかり世: It has already been 18 years since Eternal Fantasia went spectacularly eternal. The term seems to have become firmly established in society. It feels rather poignant.
texts.ちなみに、小説家になろうの無名新人作家の場合、最初の読者数は精々数十人だそうです: Incidentally, in the case of an unknown newcomer on Shōsetsuka ni Narō, apparently the initial readership is at most a few dozen people.
texts.大量の作品があるのに、わざわざ無名作家の作品を読む必要はないというか、見つけるの: Even with so many works available, there's little reason to go out of your way to read an unknown author's work—or rather, finding one is an incredibly difficult task.
texts.内容が良かろうが悪かろうが、そもそも最初は読む人が極端に少ないのだから、評価だっ: Whether the content is good or bad, hardly anyone reads it at first, so it doesn't receive any reviews or ratings either.
texts.まあ、そりゃそうだよなって感じですが。: Well, I suppose that's only natural.
texts.そこの現実を知らずに「評価が低くて落ち込む」→「エターなる」のコンボが初心者の定: Apparently, the standard beginner's pattern is to be unaware of that reality, become depressed over low ratings, and then let the work go eternal.
texts.自分は気長に頑張りながら、上を目指していこうと思います。: I intend to keep working patiently and aim higher.
texts.無論、人気が出ようが出まいが、僕はエターなりません。: Regardless of whether it becomes popular, I will never let it go eternal.
texts.自分のスキルを磨くためにも、今は作りたいものを最後まで作りたい。結局のところ、自: To hone my skills, I want to finish making what I want to make for now. In the end, that's what motivates me.
